---
title: "Lipid pump from hydrobios"
author: "Patrick Pata"
date: "2026-02-19"
output: html_document
---

This is the calculation of the lipid pump following the Tarling et al. (2022) methodology for stratified net tows.

The mean carbon content and lipid fullness of the copepods will be based on species and stage specific values from the LOKI analysis. Only C. glacialis and C. hyperboreus are considered here.



```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

# Load libraries and data
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(cowplot)
library(here)

`%notin%` <- Negate(`%in%`)

fname <- "data/2023-2024-taxo_analyses_data_patrickPata-20260203.xlsx"

# 
hydrobios <- readxl::read_xlsx(
  fname,
  sheet = "zooplankton abundances",
  # To resolve expected numeric [the sampling net ID is loaded as numeric]
  col_types = c("text","text","text","text","text","numeric","text","numeric",
                "numeric","numeric","text","text","text","text","text","text",
                "text","numeric")) %>% 
  rename(abundance_m3 = `Total abundance (ind./m3 depth computed vol)`,
         volume_filtered_m3 = depth_calc_net_filtered_vol)

hydrobios.meta <- readxl::read_xlsx(fname,
                               sheet = "sampling details")

theme_set(theme_bw() +
            theme(text = element_text(size=14)))
```

```{r}
# Load the table to match hydrobios stations with UVP profiles. Note that some hydrobios stations are associated with multiple UVP/CTD casts.
load("data/uvp_hydrobios_station_match_20260203.RData")
net.regions <- uvp_net_match %>% 
  distinct(STATION_NAME, DEPLOYMENT_DATE_START, region) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(region)) %>% 
  mutate(YEAR = substr(DEPLOYMENT_DATE_START,1,4)) %>% 
  mutate(YEAR_STATION = paste(YEAR, STATION_NAME)) %>%  
  left_join(region_rename) 

```


## Filter stations and species
```{r}
Calanus <- hydrobios %>% 
  filter(FAMILY == "Calanidae") %>% 
  # Rename taxa
  mutate(taxa = gsub("\\bsp\\.|\\bspp\\.", "", TAXON_ID)) %>% 
  mutate(genus = sub(" .*", "", taxa)) %>% 
  rename(lifeStage = TAXON_LIFE_DEV_STAGE) %>% 
  mutate(taxaStage = paste(taxa, lifeStage)) %>% 
  
  filter(taxa %in% c("Calanus glacialis", "Calanus hyperboreus")) %>% 
  filter(lifeStage %in% c("C4","C5","F")) %>% 

  # Assign dates
  mutate(datetime = as.POSIXct(paste(DEPLOYMENT_DATE_START, DEPLOYMENT_TIME_START))) %>% 
  mutate(year = year(datetime),
         month = month(datetime),
         doy = yday(datetime)) %>% 
  mutate(YEAR_STATION = paste(year, STATION_NAME)) %>% 
    
  # Calculate depth  range and midpoint
  mutate(Depth_range = MAX_SAMPLE_DEPTH - MIN_SAMPLE_DEPTH) %>% 
  mutate(Depth_mid = (MAX_SAMPLE_DEPTH + MIN_SAMPLE_DEPTH) / 2) %>% 
  
  # remove the repeated counts for RA62
  filter(!(YEAR_STATION == "2024 RA62" & SAMPLING_NET_ID %in% c("6","7"))) %>% 
  
  # # remove the station with sampling net id 1+2+...+8+9?
  # filter(SAMPLING_NET_ID != "1+2+3+4+5+6+7+8+9") %>% 
  
  # only consider stations in the UVP6 analysis
  filter(YEAR_STATION %in% net.regions$YEAR_STATION)
  

hydrobios.meta <- hydrobios.meta %>% 
   # Assign dates
  mutate(datetime = as.POSIXct(paste(DEPLOYMENT_DATE_START, DEPLOYMENT_TIME_START))) %>% 
  mutate(year = year(datetime),
         month = month(datetime),
         doy = yday(datetime)) %>% 
  mutate(YEAR_STATION = paste(year, STATION_NAME)) %>% 
  # Calculate depth  range and midpoint
  mutate(Depth_range = MAX_SAMPLE_DEPTH - MIN_SAMPLE_DEPTH) %>% 
  mutate(Depth_mid = (MAX_SAMPLE_DEPTH + MIN_SAMPLE_DEPTH) / 2) %>% 
  filter(YEAR_STATION %in% Calanus$YEAR_STATION)

```

# Get CTD data and average per depth bin
```{r}
load("data/ctd_for_hydrobios_20260219.RData")

# Add sample_id to hydrobios meta
AA <- hydrobios.meta %>% 
  left_join(uvp_net_match %>% 
              distinct(sample_id, STATION_NAME, DEPLOYMENT_DATE_START))

# Match the binning of the nets to the hydrobios
BB <- temp_hydrobios %>% 
  left_join(AA %>% 
              distinct(sample_id, MIN_SAMPLE_DEPTH, MAX_SAMPLE_DEPTH,
                       STATION_NAME, DEPLOYMENT_DATE_START,
                       BOTTOM_DEPTH),
            join_by(sample_id == sample_id,
                    pressure >= MIN_SAMPLE_DEPTH,
                    pressure < MAX_SAMPLE_DEPTH)) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(STATION_NAME))

# Calculate average temperature per bin
hydrobios.temperature <- BB %>% 
  group_by(STATION_NAME, DEPLOYMENT_DATE_START, BOTTOM_DEPTH,
           MIN_SAMPLE_DEPTH, MAX_SAMPLE_DEPTH) %>% 
  summarise(temperature = mean(te90, na.rm = T),
            salinity = mean(psal, na.rm = T),
            flor = mean(flor, na.rm = T),
            oxym = mean(oxym, na.rm = T),
            .groups = "drop")

rm(AA, BB, temp_hydrobios)
```


# Establish traits from LOKI images
```{r}
loki.segmentations <- read.csv("data/LOKI_Bourreau_manuscript/merged_LOKI2013_ecotaxa_masks_features.csv") %>% 
 
# match trait names
  mutate(total_carbon = prosome_carbon_volume + total_lipids_ugC/1000,
         # lf_carbon = fullness_ratio_carbon_volume * 100,
         lf_carbon = total_lipids_ugC/1000 / total_carbon * 100,
         waxester_carbon = total_lipids_ugC / 1000) %>% 
  #  # Recalculated version (lipid carbon not based on the variable total_lipids_carbon_volume)
  # mutate(lf_carbon = waxester_carbon / (waxester_carbon + prosome_carbon_volume) * 100) %>% 
  select(object_id, object_annotation_category,
         prosome_length_mm = prosome_major_axis_mm,
         prosome_biovolume_mm3 = prosome_volume_mm3,
         structural_carbon_mgC = prosome_carbon_volume,
         waxester_carbon_mgC = waxester_carbon,
         total_carbon_mgC = total_carbon, 
         lf_carbon) %>% 
  mutate(source = "LOKI segmented")


loki.segmentations <- loki.segmentations %>% 
  mutate(taxaStage = case_when(
    object_annotation_category == "female+lateral<Calanus hyperboreus" ~ "Calanus hyperboreus F",
    object_annotation_category == "cvstage+lateral<Calanus hyperboreus" ~ "Calanus hyperboreus C5",
    object_annotation_category == "civstage+lateral<Calanus hyperboreus" ~ "Calanus hyperboreus C4",
    object_annotation_category == "female+lateral<Calanus glacialis" ~ "Calanus glacialis F",
    object_annotation_category == "cvstage+lateral<Calanus glacialis" ~ "Calanus glacialis C5",
    object_annotation_category == "civstage+lateral<Calanus glacialis" ~ "Calanus glacialis C4",
    TRUE ~ object_annotation_category
  ) )

# Calculate average by taxa stage
loki.averages <- loki.segmentations %>% 
  group_by(taxaStage) %>% 
  summarise(across(prosome_length_mm:lf_carbon,
                   \(x) mean(x, na.rm = T)),
            n = n(),
            .groups = "drop")
```



# Calculate lipid pump
```{r}
# Coefficients of the dormant/diapause respiration equation (Maps et al. 2014):
bb <- 2.27# Metabolic constant (x 10-7)
eV <- 0.6 # Activation energy
bb_se <- 0.37 # Standard error of the metabolic constant
eV_se <- 0.092 # Standard error of the activation energy
beta <- -0.001 # natural mortality rate (day-1)

Calanus.pump <- Calanus %>% 
  # exclude 2 stations with no CTD data
  filter(STATION_NAME %notin% c("RA09", "RA27")) %>% 
  # add trait information
  left_join(loki.averages %>% 
              select(-n),
            by = "taxaStage") %>% 
 
  # Add in situ temperature
  left_join(hydrobios.temperature,
            by = join_by(STATION_NAME, DEPLOYMENT_DATE_START, 
                         MIN_SAMPLE_DEPTH, MAX_SAMPLE_DEPTH)) %>% 
  # for AF-23 when there are no ctd data at deepest bins, use the mean temperature for that sample
  group_by(STATION_NAME, DEPLOYMENT_DATE_START) %>% 
  mutate(temperature = if_else(is.na(temperature),
                               mean(temperature, na.rm = T),
                               temperature)) %>% 
  mutate(temperature_kelvin = temperature + 273.15) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  
  # Calculate diapause respiration rate and duration
  mutate(mass_ugC = structural_carbon_mgC * 1000,
         WE_ugC = waxester_carbon_mgC * 1000) %>% 
  mutate(respirationRate_ugCday = 
           (bb*10^-7 ) * (mass_ugC^0.75) * 
           exp(eV * (temperature_kelvin-273)/ 
                 ((8.62*10^-5)*temperature_kelvin*273)) * 86400) %>% 
  mutate(diapauseDuration_day = 
           (0.8*WE_ugC)/(respirationRate_ugCday)) %>% 

  # Cap the diapause duration capped to 240 days
  mutate(diapauseDuration_day_cap = if_else(diapauseDuration_day > 240,
                                                240, diapauseDuration_day)) %>% 
  # The total C respired for the entire duration of diapause by the individual (ug C)
  mutate(diapause_resp_by_indiv_ugC = 
           respirationRate_ugCday * diapauseDuration_day_cap) %>%  
  
  # Calculate abundance by area
  mutate(abundance_m2 = abundance_m3 * Depth_range) %>% 
  # Convert abundance to biomass
  mutate(biomass_mgC_m2 = abundance_m2 * total_carbon_mgC) %>% 
  
  # Convert respired C to /m2 (Abund * Duration * Rate) 
  mutate(Rtot_mgC_m2 = abundance_m2 * diapause_resp_by_indiv_ugC / 1000) %>% 

  # Calculate mortality
  mutate(Nmortality =  abundance_m2 * exp(beta * diapauseDuration_day_cap)) %>% 
  # Calculate storage (Stot) and structural (Utot) from mortality
  mutate(Stot_mgC_m2 = (abundance_m2 - Nmortality) * waxester_carbon_mgC,
         Utot_mgC_m2 = (abundance_m2 - Nmortality) * structural_carbon_mgC) %>% 
  
  # Total lipid pump components
  mutate(Ftot_mgC_m2 = Rtot_mgC_m2 + Stot_mgC_m2 + Utot_mgC_m2) %>% 
  
  select(-c(mass_ugC, WE_ugC, diapauseDuration_day_cap, Nmortality)) 
```

# Integrate per cast
```{r}
# integrate all depth bins
hydrobios.pump <- Calanus.pump %>% 
  group_by(YEAR_STATION, taxaStage) %>% 
  summarise(abundance_m2 = sum(abundance_m2),
            biomass_mgC_m2 = sum(biomass_mgC_m2),
            Ftot_gC_m2 = sum(Ftot_mgC_m2) / 1000,
            Rtot_gC_m2 = sum(Rtot_mgC_m2) / 1000,
            Stot_gC_m2 = sum(Stot_mgC_m2) / 1000,
            Utot_gC_m2 = sum(Utot_mgC_m2) / 1000,
            .groups = "drop") %>% 
  mutate(taxaStage2 = str_remove(taxaStage, "Calanus "))


# Contribution of taxa to total flux
ggplot(hydrobios.pump, aes(x = YEAR_STATION, y = Ftot_gC_m2,
                           fill = taxaStage2)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "stack") +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0,0)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("royalblue","darkturquoise","navy",
                               "pink","hotpink", "violetred4"),
                    name = "Calanus") +
  ylab("Lipid pump (g C m-2 y-1)") +
  theme(legend.position = "right",
        axis.title.x = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5))
```

## Map results
```{r}
hydrobios.pump.profiles <- Calanus.pump %>% 
  group_by(YEAR_STATION) %>% 
  summarise(abundance_m2 = sum(abundance_m2),
            biomass_mgC_m2 = sum(biomass_mgC_m2),
            Ftot_gC_m2 = sum(Ftot_mgC_m2) / 1000,
            Rtot_gC_m2 = sum(Rtot_mgC_m2) / 1000,
            Stot_gC_m2 = sum(Stot_mgC_m2) / 1000,
            Utot_gC_m2 = sum(Utot_mgC_m2) / 1000,
            .groups = "drop") %>% 
  left_join(hydrobios.meta %>% 
              distinct(YEAR_STATION, LONGITUDE, LATITUDE,
                     year, month, doy),
            by = "YEAR_STATION") %>% 
  left_join(net.regions %>% 
              select(YEAR_STATION, region.inuktitut),
            by = "YEAR_STATION")



library(ggOceanMaps)
basemap("ArcticStereographic", bathymetry = FALSE, glaciers = FALSE,
        limits = c(-85,-52,65,83), rotate = T,
        legends = TRUE, land.col = "gray60",  bathy.style = "contour_grays",
        land.border.col = "black", gla.border.col = NA) +
  ggspatial::geom_spatial_point(data = hydrobios.pump.profiles,
                                aes(x = LONGITUDE, y = LATITUDE,
                                    shape = region.inuktitut,
                                    fill = Ftot_gC_m2),
                                size = 3, alpha = 0.8) +
  # scale_shape_manual(values = c(21,22,23,25,22,23), guide = "none") +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(22,23,25,21,23,22), guide = "none") +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "plasma", direction = -1, 
                       name = "Lipid pump\n(g C m-2 y-1)") +
 theme(axis.title = element_blank(),
        legend.position = c(0.05, 0.05), 
        legend.justification = c("left", "bottom"),
        legend.margin = ggplot2::margin(6,6,6,6),
        legend.box.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "black"))

ggsave("figures/hydrobios_map_lipidpump.png", width = 5, height = 6,
       units = "in", bg = "white")
```


# Compare net-based flux with the UVP-based flux
```{r}
load("data/profile_integrated_cflux_20260202.RData")

uvp.pump.profiles <- df.profile %>% 
  filter(taxa == "Calanus") 

# Match profiles
pump.net.uvp <- uvp_net_match %>% 
  mutate(YEAR = substr(DEPLOYMENT_DATE_START,1,4)) %>% 
  mutate(YEAR_STATION = paste(YEAR, STATION_NAME)) %>%  
  # Add the hydrobios estimated C flux
  left_join(hydrobios.pump.profiles %>% 
              select(YEAR_STATION, Net_CFlux_gC_m2 = Ftot_gC_m2),
            by = join_by(YEAR_STATION)) %>% 
  # Add the UVP estimated C flux
  left_join(uvp.pump.profiles %>% 
              select(sample_id, UVP_CFlux_gC_m2 = total_gC_flux_m2,
                     region.inuktitut)) %>% 
  
  filter(!is.na(UVP_CFlux_gC_m2)) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(Net_CFlux_gC_m2))

segments_df <- pump.net.uvp %>%
  group_by(STATION_NAME, DEPLOYMENT_DATE_START, region.inuktitut) %>%
  summarise(
    y = first(Net_CFlux_gC_m2),
    x_min = min(UVP_CFlux_gC_m2, na.rm = TRUE),
    x_max = max(UVP_CFlux_gC_m2, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(n > 1)  


ggplot(pump.net.uvp, 
       aes(x = UVP_CFlux_gC_m2, y = Net_CFlux_gC_m2)) +
  geom_abline() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", color = "black", linetype = "dashed") +
   geom_segment(data = segments_df,
    aes(x = x_min, xend = x_max, y = y, yend = y), 
    color = "gray", show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_point(aes(color = region.inuktitut), size = 3) +
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  scale_x_log10() + scale_y_log10() +
  scale_color_manual(values = unique(region_rename$region.color),
                     name = "Region") +
  xlab("UVP Lipid Pump (g C m-2 y-1)") +
  ylab("Net Lipid Pump (g C m-2 y-1)")
```

# Regional averages
```{r}

# Calculate averages of net integrated data (n = 49 casts)
region.hydrobios <- pump.net.uvp %>% 
  distinct(YEAR_STATION, STATION_NAME, DEPLOYMENT_DATE_START,
           Net_CFlux_gC_m2,
           region.inuktitut) %>% 
  group_by(region.inuktitut) %>% 
  summarise(across(c(Net_CFlux_gC_m2),
            list(mean = mean, sd = sd, min = min, max = max),
              na.rm = TRUE),
            n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>% 
  # Calculate standard errors
  mutate(Net_CFlux_gC_m2_se = Net_CFlux_gC_m2_sd / sqrt(n))

# Calculate averages of UVP data (for n=81 profiles matching nets)
region.uvpmatch <- pump.net.uvp %>% 
  distinct(sample_id, UVP_CFlux_gC_m2,
           region.inuktitut) %>% 
  group_by(region.inuktitut) %>% 
  summarise(across(c(UVP_CFlux_gC_m2),
            list(mean = mean, sd = sd, min = min, max = max),
              na.rm = TRUE),
            n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>% 
  # Calculate standard errors
  mutate(UVP_CFlux_gC_m2_se = UVP_CFlux_gC_m2_sd / sqrt(n))

df <- left_join(region.hydrobios, region.uvpmatch, by = "region.inuktitut") %>% 
  droplevels()

ggplot(df, aes( x = UVP_CFlux_gC_m2_mean, y = Net_CFlux_gC_m2_mean)) +
  geom_abline() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = F, linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
  geom_point(size = 5, aes(color = region.inuktitut)) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = Net_CFlux_gC_m2_mean-Net_CFlux_gC_m2_se,
                    ymax = Net_CFlux_gC_m2_mean+Net_CFlux_gC_m2_se,
                    color = region.inuktitut), 
                show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(xmin = UVP_CFlux_gC_m2_mean-UVP_CFlux_gC_m2_se,
                    xmax = UVP_CFlux_gC_m2_mean+UVP_CFlux_gC_m2_se,
                    color = region.inuktitut), 
                show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_color_manual(values = region_rename$region.color,
                     name = "Region") +
  geom_text(aes(label = n.x), color = "black") +
  xlab("UVP Lipid Pump (g C m-2 y-1)") +
  ylab("Net Lipid Pump (g C m-2 y-1)") +
  theme(legend.position = "none")


ggsave("figures/hydrobios_lipidpump_comparison_regions_SE.png",
       width = 4, height = 4, units = "in", bg = "white")
```
